question: How is the Goddess connected to the wife of the ten-headed one?
premises: The Goddess is the life of the ten-headed one's wife.
The Goddess delights in the ten-headed one's wife.
inference: The Goddess is intimately bound to the wife of the ten-headed one as her life and source of delight.
uncertainties: The ten-headed one and his wife are not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She is the life of the ten-headed one's wife and delights in the ten-headed one's wife.
